patterns.note: Full-bleed hero and section images are used extensively to create an immersive visual experience, often with text overlaid or adjacent to the imagery.
Sections alternate between light (off-white) and dark (black) backgrounds, creating a strong visual rhythm and clear content separation.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for impact and hierarchy, contrasted with smaller, highly legible body text for detailed information.
A vibrant red accent color is strategically applied to calls to action and key interactive elements, standing out against the site's largely monochromatic and natural palette.
The hero background image employs a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground content to add depth.
The primary navigation bar transforms from transparent over the hero to a solid dark background with white text, becoming sticky after the hero section scrolls out of view.
Infographic-style sections utilize simple line-art icons and concise text blocks to explain features and benefits, maintaining a clean aesthetic.

technique_notes: Full-bleed hero and section images are used to create an immersive visual experience, often with text overlaid directly on the image or in a contrasting content block.
Scroll-triggered animations reveal content sections with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, managed by a smooth scrolling library like Locomotive Scroll.

The main navigation bar dynamically changes its appearance and stickiness: it starts transparent over the hero, then gains a subtle backdrop blur, and finally adopts a solid dark background and sticks to the top of the viewport after the hero section is scrolled past.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, highly legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements and containers, maintaining a clean and modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero and between major sections provides breathing room, while content blocks maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive use of high-quality, full-bleed photography of cabins in stunning natural landscapes, combined with a clean, minimal design and subtle scroll-triggered motion, creates an immersive and aspirational brand experience that feels both luxurious and grounded.
